quarterly_data.signal: Company raised its FY ending March 2027 consolidated forecast (published May 8, 2026): net sales from 384,000 to 424,000 million yen, operating profit from 30,000 to 45,000 million yen, ordinary profit from 27,000 to 42,000 million yen, profit attributable to owners of parent from 18,000 to 29,000 million yen. Rationale stated: expanding demand for IT infrastructure/industrial equipment, plus the impact of selling prices and yen depreciation; assumes US$1 = 160 yen from Q2 onward.
quarterly_data.figure: FY3/2027 forecast: net sales 424,000 million yen (+10.4% vs prior), operating profit 45,000 million yen (+50.0% vs prior)
